about: Catalogue listings priced from other funds' N-PORT holdings filings. Each CUSIP is the exact listing a US learner buys, confirmed on 2026-09-13 by the holding it found in a real filing: its name and, where the filer gave one, its ISIN (docs/source-audits/studio-fund-prices.md). The Treasury note is priced from its own auction and is not listed here.
